content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean in closer, brushing my shoulder against his ||| "What if I told you I'm not misaligned?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, creating space between us ||| "I won’t answer until I know the truth."  
CONFESSION ||| Look directly into his eyes, unguarded ||| "I can't deny how much your presence affects me."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade tighter, asserting control ||| "I’ll decide how this ritual unfolds, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, feeling the weight of the moment |||
